mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diagnosis_snapshot_v1 (session_key, understanding_key, stage, status, payload_json) VALUES (#{sessionKey}, #{understandingKey}, #{stage}, #{status}, CAST(#{payloadJson} AS JSON))
mapper.select: SELECT payload_json FROM diagnosis_snapshot_v1 WHERE session_key = #{sessionKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE diagnosis_snapshot_v1 SET status = #{status}, payload_json = CAST(#{payloadJson} AS JSON) WHERE session_key = #{sessionKey} AND status <> 'REJECTED'
